refusal_text_boundary.fact: No text raised through fail() (terrain/terrain.mjs) is a line of ANY owner surface this artifact grammars. fail() writes to stderr and exits.
refusal_text_boundary.scope: global — it holds for every surface here, covered or uncovered, and each surface restates it rather than inheriting it silently
refusal_text_boundary.stated_by_mechanism_not_enumeration: The boundary names the FUNCTION, not a list of messages. A list goes stale on the next fail() added and leaves message N+1 uncovered by default — the shape §14.1 and §9 both chose against.
refusal_text_boundary.reopen_trigger: the first owner-facing refusal text written to stdout, or into the report file, rather than raised through fail() — that one is on a surface and owes a line class

SuggestionID.disjoint_from_LessonDisplayID: DECLARED DISJOINT from ^L[0-9]+$ (§14.6). §14.3 assigns a display_id ONCE, in the survey record; a suggestion is by construction NOT in that record, so nothing there assigns it one. expressible.rule: zero `lesson:` tokens and zero element names on an owner surface
every token in a member-list position matches tokens.LessonDisplayID
the Lesson count of a group's `(fits no composed SubGroup)` SubGroup divided by the SUM of that group's `subgroup_heading` LessonCounts <= 0.30
a line whose class is not in the surface's line_classes ⇒ REFUSE
every Group heading carries a GroupID matching tokens.GroupID, and every SubGroup heading a SubGroupID matching tokens.SubGroupID
a `group_heading_flat` line whose LessonCount is >= 10 must be followed by at least one `subgroup_heading` line before the next group heading

not_expressible.rule: sum of LessonCount over a group's `subgroup_heading` lines == that group's own member count
not_expressible.why_not_expressible: The rendered text no longer carries one side of the comparison: the subdivided group heading carries no parent count. Re-pointing the rule at the sum of the SubGroup counts would compare a quantity to itself, which is a predicate that cannot fail.
not_expressible.carried_instead: A pre-render refusal in `cmdCotags`, over the placement rather than the rendered text. It fires on DOUBLE placement — one member named in two SubGroups — which is the reachable direction; under-placement cannot occur, because the placement sweeps unplaced members into the catch-all.
not_expressible.what_the_siting_costs: The refusal reads the DATA and the withdrawn rule read the TEXT, so a renderer that omits a whole `subgroup_heading` line is invisible to this surface's refusal. The golden specimen and `catch_all_share`'s reading of the same counts still bound it; neither is an equivalent.
not_expressible.reopen_trigger: the first `cotag_screen` line class that carries a group's own member count again — a re-ruled heading, a per-group footer, or any other line the parent count reaches — at which point this entry moves back into `expressible` with its predicate restored

deferred_slot_full_report_allowlist.what_is_owed: A decision on whether full_report's three bare-placeholder body classes (`group_claim_body`, `subgroup_claim_body`, `member_gloss_body`) are constrained, so that `line_class_allowlist` becomes live on this surface -- or whether a SECTIONED allowlist is admitted instead, refusing only lines under a heading whose section declares a closed class set. The second shape would make the rule live for the neighborhood section without touching the claim bodies at all.
